caption: The drawing features a long, double-breasted coat depicted in shades of dark brown and black, with detailed rendering of shadows and highlights to indicate fabric folds and contours. The coat has wide, notched lapels, and four decorative buttons arranged in two vertical rows on the front. The lower half of the coat includes a broad, darker vertical panel that extends from the waist down to the hem, contrasting with the lighter brown main body. The sleeves are long and fitted, ending in cuffs. The background is a plain, off-white color. In the upper right corner of the drawing, there is a smaller, faint line sketch of the same coat shown from the back, providing an outline of its rear structure, seams, and fit.
title: Tail Coat
